package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var m map[string]int
	fmt.Println(m["missing"])
	func() {
		defer func() { fmt.Println("recovered:", recover()) }()
		m["x"] = 1
	}()
	var p *struct{ X int }
	func() {
		defer func() { fmt.Println("recovered:", recover() != nil) }()
		fmt.Println(p.X)
	}()
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("custom %d", 42))
}
